Theme colors come from the accent palette and follow light and
Requires U3: owned PTY and shell session, byte streams, modes and resize, raw and canonical input, hidden secrets, jobs, EOF and cancel. Prompt marks need shell cooperation.
The kernel Terminal stays as a recovery host until the native one proves itself. No privileged command-string RPC. Layouts and tabs need no new ABI; inline images and clipboard do.
Sample package, host and frame values are illustrative. Only the top bar, tabs, panes and status bar are the proposed baseline; hints, rail and images can arrive in stages.
